text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock B and Stock C after gains, but that did not prevent my account value from falling; a quick rise alone is not a reason to sell.","I should set clear reasons and rules for selling—such as a changed outlook or planned rebalancing—instead of taking profits impulsively.","I should review my whole portfolio periodically, including losing positions, rather than letting my tendency to hold decliners shape my decisions."]}
